solution_summary: WPS Software Accelerates Smart Office Innovation with Generative AI, Deploying AI Features in Just 2 Months WPS Software , a global provider of office productivity software, supports millions of users worldwide with its flagship product, WPS Office. Driven by its "All in AI" initiative, WPS Software launched WPS AI, an intelligent assistant embedded in WPS Office, designed to enhance smart office capabilities with features like advanced spell check, document polishing, and automated PowerPoint generation. WPS Software selected Amazon Web Services (AWS) for its robust, scalable infrastructure and diverse AI model options. By deploying WPS AI on AWS, WPS Software achieved a 30 percent increase in R&D efficiency and a 35 percent reduction in operational costs, delivering transformative AI-driven tools that enhance productivity and user experience across its global user base.
